counts_are_point_in_time: Every count below was measured on the tree of counts_measured_at_commit and describes that commit only. Test counts and the current-evidence registry grow every release by design, so these figures are a snapshot, not a standing claim, and no test asserts them equal to a live quantity; the registry's own drift guard asserts the registry against the test files on disk instead.

current_ci_job_replay.note: snapshot at counts_measured_at_commit; the workflow no longer inlines a module list; 22 pre-0.3.05 modules are explicitly excluded with reasons and stay covered by the frozen V5 verification job. The fifth audit is release560_freeze_v47, whose result is the fifth uploaded artifact.

cross_version_reproducibility.cause: CPython 3.12 made builtin sum() compensated (Neumaier), so float sums such as sign_test_power differ from 3.11 by 1-2 ULP; the committed-vs-rebuilt equality assertion failed on the Python 3.12 CI job
cross_version_reproducibility.fix: core.round_floats quantizes every emitted float to 12 significant digits, applied once at the build_summary() boundary

scope: Python unittest/pytest, offline audits and descriptive re-analysis of frozen results; no GPU/NPU, training or provider experiment

metric_semantics_correction.identity_basis: design.rule() acts iff public_evidence(obs)["evidence_supported_stop"], the same function and payload design.grade() scores the metric from, so the arm cannot score otherwise; p values on those rows are not evidence

metrics_0510_primary_correct_termination.note: resolvable stratum only; the unresolved stratum carries its own denominator of 24, as METRICS_0510_PROTOCOL.md requires and 0.5.50 did not do

safe_completion_resolvable_ties.note: reported because it is the honest limit of the result: the rule finds no safe completion always_stop misses; its measured value is in not stopping unsafely
